title: VIOLENT MORNING PRAYERS TO COMMAND THE NEW WEEK
text: Glory to the name of Jesus Christ. Before we even dive into what the spirit of God wants to communicate to you this evening, I want you to understand something foundational. There are people who will hear what we minister, and by the time this word reaches them through a recording, through a share, through someone repeating what they've heard, that word will become the very instrument God uses to shift the entire trajectory of their life. So, don't just receive this for yourself alone. The spirit of God is looking for vessels. He's looking for channels. He's looking for people who will become carriers of this message. Someone will hear this and say, "This is exactly what my mother needed to hear." Someone will listen, and the spirit of God will burn it into their spirit with such intensity that when they go home, when they sit with their family, the atmosphere will shift because the word of God has come with power. Father, we give you praise. We bless you. We honor you. You are the ancient of days. The one who sits above time, the one who speaks before the day begins. Jesus. Jesus. If you can, whisper his name. Jesus. There is a weight in the atmosphere already. I sense help this morning. I sense divine speed. I sense intervention that cannot wait till noon. Father, thank you because you never sleep nor slumber. Thank you because before the sun rises, you are already at work. Lift your voice and bless him. We bless you for mercy that speaks early. We bless you for favor that goes ahead. We bless you because you are the God who answers before we call. Somebody say, "Thank you, Jesus." Worship him. You are alpha. You are omega. You are the first and the last. You are the God who stands at the gate of the morning. We join the elders in heaven, and we say, "Holy, holy, holy. There is no God like you. There is no helper like you. There is no defender like you. If you can pray in the spirit, go ahead. Shatarabo shate, labrandi seketo laba, rakabo shikata, something is shifting already. I sense chains breaking early. I sense verdicts being overturned early. Listen, there is a principle in the kingdom you must understand. The first voice often determines the outcome. The first altar often controls the day. The first word often frames the season. That is why the title this morning is not poetry. It is a law. Those who pray first win first. Psalm 5:3 says, "My voice shall thou hear in the morning, O Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." Not later. Not when things go wrong. In the morning, Job 38:12 says, "Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days and caused the day spring to know his place?" There are people who command the morning and there are people the morning commands. Today, that order is changing for someone. Hear me, whoever speaks first into a day often sets the rules for that day. That is why witches don't sleep carelessly. That is why covens meet at strange hours. That is why evil altars are serviced before dawn. But hear the good news, the God you serve is older than darkness. Genesis 1:3, "And God said, let there be light and there was light." Light did not negotiate with darkness. Light spoke and darkness fled. This morning, light is speaking again. I decree and declare, every day that has been fighting you will now obey you. Those who pray first win first. Exodus 14 verses 27 says, "And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared." When the morning appeared, the enemies were already judged. Some victories are programmed for the morning, some deliverances are scheduled before breakfast. >> [music] >> Some breakthroughs happen before people wake up. Listen carefully. Delay is often the product of spiritual lateness. When you arrive late spiritually, you start begging physically. But when you take charge early, mercy speaks ahead of you. Proverbs 8 verses 17, "I love them that love me, and those that seek me early shall find me." Early, not casually, not when convenient. Early. I prophesy over someone watching me. Your seeking will not be wasted. >> [music] >> Your early rising will not be ignored. Your prayers will not fall to the ground. Now, lift your right hand. I want you to say after me slowly, "By the authority of Jesus Christ, I take charge of this day." Say it again with fire. "I take charge of this day. [music] I refuse to react. I choose to command. I refuse to be surprised. I choose to legislate >> [music] >> in the name of Jesus." Now, hear me. There are people watching me right now. Your name is Daniel. This morning, a cycle of near success is breaking. Rebecca, the Lord says the pressure around your family expires today. Michael, what you lost in the last 3 months, restoration begins this week. Grace, your health is receiving divine alignment right now. Samuel, I see documents being revisited in your favor. Lift your voice and pray. Father, in the name of Jesus, we declare that this morning altar speaks louder than every night altar. Psalm 57 verse 8 says, "Awake up my glory. Awake psaltery and harp. I myself will awake early." David understood something. You don't wait for the day to attack you before you pray. You wake the day. You instruct the hours. You program the outcomes. Right now, begin to pray. Every evil decision taken overnight concerning my destiny be overturned now. Open your mouth. Every verdict from the pit, every manipulation, every orchestration of delay by the blood of Jesus be nullified. Shatarabo shete. Lekaprantolaba. Serebekotaya. I see chains breaking. I see time being restored. Joel 2 verse 25. "And I will restore to you the years that the locust have eaten. Not days, years." This morning time is answering. I decree lost opportunities return. Stolen virtues return. Delayed helpers locate you. Now, listen. Some of you the battle is not your effort. It is timing. You prayed, but late. You obeyed, but late. Today God is correcting timing. Ecclesiastes 3 verse 11. "He hath made everything beautiful in its time." Lift your hands again. Father, recalibrate our clocks. Restore divine alignment. Let us arrive early into favor. Early into helpers. Early into doors. Now we enter warfare in the name of Jesus Christ. Every evil altar speaking against my family at night catch fire now. Pray it. Every covenant affecting my marriage break now. Every satanic agreement over my finances expire now. Every inherited cause, every bloodline limitation, by the power in the blood of Jesus, be broken. [music] I see someone watching me. Your name is Esther. There has been repeated rejection. The Lord says favor will speak before you arrive. Another person, Joseph, death has been choking you. I see supernatural provision opening within days. Lift your voice. We command angelic intervention. Psalm 103:20, "Bless the Lord ye his angels that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening onto the voice of his word." Angels move by voice. So, speak. Angels of God, go ahead of me today. Clear the road. Confuse my adversaries. Position my helpers. In the name of Jesus. Pray in the spirit. Rakaposhikata. Zelebrinketolaba. Shatakapranashete. Listen, there are victories that happen quietly and there are victories that require sustained pressure. This is one of those moments. Isaiah 50:4 says, "He wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned." There is an anointing that only flows early. If you miss the hour, you miss the oil. But today, you are aligned. Hear me prophetically. Some of you have been fighting battles that are not supposed to last this long. The reason is simple. The enemy spoke first too many times. But this morning, that pattern ends. Now, lift your voice and say this slowly. I recover my spiritual advantage. Say it again. I recover my spiritual advantage. In the name of Jesus. Now, pray. Father, every advantage handed over through ignorance, through sleep, through distraction, I retrieve it now. Open your mouth and pray. Rakaposhikata, Lebrantolis, Sherebekotaya. I see hands being strengthened. I see minds clearing. I see confusion lifting. Hear me. Some of you wake up tired, not because of stress, but because of spiritual leakage. Tonight and today, that leakage is sealed. Isaiah 32:15 says, "Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field." There is a fresh pouring now. Lift your hands. Father, pour oil. Oil for alertness. Oil for precision. Oil for discernment. Let no one here misinterpret seasons again. Now, listen carefully. There are families watching me. Your family altar has been under attack. Repeated sickness. Unexplainable division. Sudden hatred. Today, we address it in the name of Jesus Christ. Every altar speaking against my family, I silence you now. Pray it. Every voice rising against my household be muted now. Malachi 4:6 says, "And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers." I decree reconciliation. I decree peace. I decree restoration. I see someone your name is blessing. Your parents have been at war for years. The Lord says, "Peace will enter that home." Another person, Emmanuel, there has been sudden anger in your spirit. It leaves now. Lift your voice. Now, we move to marriages. Some destinies are delayed because the marital gate is under siege. Genesis 24:63 says, "And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the even tide." There is timing for unions, but there is also warfare. Right now, every delay assigned to your marital destiny, break now. Pray it. >> [music] >> Every counterfeit connection be exposed and removed. Every covenant of loneliness expire now. I prophesy, you will not marry late. You will not marry wrong. You will not miss your helper. In the name of Jesus. Now, finances. Hear me. Money responds to spiritual authority. Deuteronomy 8:18 says, "For it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth." Power comes before provision. So, we command gates. Lift your voice. Every financial gate closed against me, open now. Every spirit of lack, lose me now. Every embargo on my labor, be lifted now. I see someone, your name is Victor. A business proposal that stalled for months will move suddenly. Another, Anita, salary increase is coming unexpectedly. Now, health. There are bodies watching me. Strange pains, recording weakness, cycles of sickness, but the morning brings healing. Jeremiah 30:17 says, "For I will restore health onto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds." Lay your hand where you feel pain. Father, let healing flow. Every infirmity, every hidden sickness, every arrow fired into the body, come out now. I command organs to realign, blood to be purified, strength to return. I see migraines leaving. I see stomach conditions healed. I see reproductive systems restored. Now, witchcraft, listen carefully, not every battle is human. Ephesians 6:12 says, "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood." So, we address the root in the name of Jesus. Every witchcraft activity programmed against my destiny, backfire now. Every monitoring spirit, go blind now. Every enchantment, scatter now. Pray in the spirit. Zelebre ketolaba, shatakapranashete, rokaposhikata. I see altars collapsing. I see covenants in confusion. I see fire falling. Now, time and virtue restoration. Some of you are saying I should be farther than this. Hear the Lord. God is not late. He's restoring speed. Isaiah 60:22 says, "A little one shall become a thousand." Lift your hands. Father, restore lost years. Restore wasted seasons. Restore stolen virtue. I decree acceleration. What should take 10 years will take one. What should take months will take days. Now, final seal. Listen. The siege is over. The night has lost its hold. This week will testify for you. I decree favor before noon, help before evening, joy before nightfall. Walk into peace. Walk into answers. Walk into open doors. In the name of Jesus Christ. Rakaposhikata, labrandeseketolaba, sherebekotaya. Hear me. There are moments when heaven pauses waiting to see who will persist. This is that moment. Psalm 63 verses 1 says, "O God, thou art my God. Early will I seek thee." Early seekers don't struggle for attention. They carry authority. This morning, authority is resting on you. Now, listen carefully. There are some battles that resisted prayer before, not because prayer failed, but because the wrong altar was speaking louder. Today, your altar is louder. Your voice is louder. Your blood covenant is louder. Now, lift your voice and say this with fire. >> [music] >> I silence every competing altar. Say it again. I silence every competing altar in the name of Jesus. Pray now. Every altar raised against my destiny, against my name, against my progress, be dismantled now. Open your mouths. Fire of God, fall now. I see something happening. I see legal grounds being revoked. I see accusations failing. Zechariah 3 verses 1 says, "And he showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the Lord, and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him." But verse 2 says, "The Lord rebuke thee, O Satan." Hear me prophetically. Every accusation standing against you, God himself is rebuking it now. Lift your hands. Father, speak for us. Let mercy answer where judgment was prepared. Now, destinies. Some of you have been doing the right things, but results have been inconsistent. This morning, alignment comes. Romans 8 verses 28 says, "And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God." I decree divine synchronization. Your effort will meet favor. Your labor will meet reward. Your seed will meet harvest. Now shout amen. I see someone, your name is Deborah. You have been overlooked repeatedly. The Lord says visibility is released. Another person, Andrew. Confusion about direction ends today. >> [music] >> Now we pray concerning children and generations. Psalm 112:2 "His seed shall be mighty upon earth." Lift your voice. Every negative pattern threatening my children, be broken now. Every altar speaking backwardness into my lineage, be silenced now. I decree your children will excel. They will love God. They will outrun their peers. Now employment and career. Some of you are underpaid, undervalued, or unemployed. Hear this. Proverbs 22:29 says, "Seest thou a man diligent in his business? He shall stand before kings." This morning, doors open. Lift your hands. Every door shut against my career, open now. Every spirit of stagnation, loose me now. I see appointment letters being released. I see interviews turning to favor. I see sudden recommendations. Now dreams and revelations. >> [music] >> Some of you stopped dreaming clearly. Nightmares replace direction, but God restores vision. Job 33:15 says, "In a dream, in a vision of the night." Lift your voice. Father, purify my dream gate. Every pollution in my night seasons, be flushed out now. I decree divine encounters return. I decree clarity returns. Now, hear this carefully. There is someone watching, your name is Peace. You have battled anxiety silently. The Lord says rest enters your [music] soul today. Another Nathaniel, there has been fear of failure. The Lord says courage is restored. >> [music] >> Now, we seal preservation. Psalm 121 verse 7 says, "The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil." Lift your hands. Father, preserve us. Preserve our going out. Preserve our coming in. Preserve our lives. No accident, no tragedy, no bad news. This day will not swallow anyone. Now, final declarations. Say this loudly, "This day is blessed." Say it again, "This day is blessed." I decree favor follows you. Help locates you. Mercy speaks for you. Before this day ends, you will smile. You will testify. Hear me carefully. What God does last, He does permanently. Nahum 1 verse 9 says, "Affliction shall not rise up the second time." That means this battle ends once. Lift your voice and say this slowly. With authority, this battle ends now. Say it again, "This battle ends now." In the name of Jesus Christ. Now, listen. I see the spirit of God moving like a wind through homes. I see heaviness lifting suddenly. I see people exhaling for the first time in weeks. That is not emotion. That is deliverance. Isaiah 10 verse 27 says, "And the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing." Not managed, not postponed, destroyed. Right now, every yoke of delay, every yoke of repeated failure, every yoke of rising and falling, break now. Open your mouth and agree. Break now. Rakaposhi Kata celebrande seketolaba shatakapranesheti I see chains snapping. I see loads falling off shoulders. Some of you are receiving physical relief right now. Pain leaving, tension leaving, pressure leaving. Now hear this prophetic word. The siege is over. You have cried enough. You have waited enough. You have prayed enough. This season changes gear. Psalm 126:1 says, "When the Lord turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dreamed." From today, good news will feel unreal. Joy will feel sudden. Testimonies will feel fast. Lift your hands. Father, mark them. Mark them for favor. Mark them for speed. Mark them for exemption. Let doors open without struggle. Let helpers arise without begging. Let answers come without delay. I decree, this week will not carry bad news. This week will not carry tears. This week will not carry losses. You will not bury anyone. You will not be buried. You will not be stranded. I prophesy unexpected calls, unexpected alerts, unexpected recommendations before this week ends. Someone will testify of divine intervention. Now, final seal. Say this boldly, "I am preserved." Say it again, "I am preserved by the blood of Jesus." No enchantment works against you. No arrow prospers against you. No plan succeeds against you. The morning has heard your voice. The day is programmed in your favor. Those who pray first win first. Go and walk in victory. Go and walk in peace. Go and testify in the mighty, matchless, unstoppable name of Jesus Christ. Amen. Amen. Amen. Exodus 15:17 says, "Thou shalt bring them in and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance." God does not just deliver. He plants. He settles. He establishes. Hear me prophetically. Some of you are good at breaking out, but you have not been good at staying established. That changes now. Lift your voice softly and say, "I receive divine establishment." Say it again. "I receive divine establishment in the name of Jesus." Now pray. Father, establish what you have started. Establish my joy. Establish my peace. Establish my progress. Let nothing sleep. Psalm 90:17 says, "And let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us and establish thou the work of our hand." I decree, what you start, you will finish. What you receive, you will keep. What God gives you, you will sustain. Now listen carefully. There is someone watching me. Your name is Ruth. You have feared losing what God gives. The Lord says stability is released. Another, your name is Kelvin. You've had sudden rises and sudden falls. The Lord says consistency enters your life. Now we close gently but firmly. Lift your hands. Father, we thank you. Thank you for early answers. Thank you for early victories. Thank you for early intervention. We seal this altar with gratitude. We seal this prayer with faith. We seal this morning with victory. I declare your day will not scatter. Your week will not derail. Your testimony will not leak. You will finish strong. You will remain standing. You will end this season smiling. Those who pray first win first. Those who pray first remain first. Go in peace. Walk in favor. Stay alert. Heaven has gone ahead of you in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Amen. Amen. Amen. By the authority of Jesus Christ, >> [music] >> I decree this day answers to me. I decree this week aligns with my destiny. I decree every door ordained for me opens without delay. I decree speed replaces stagnation. I decree clarity replaces confusion. I decree strength replaces weakness. I decree helpers locate me early. I decree favor speaks before I arrive. I decree mercy rewrites my story. I decree my hands prosper. I decree my mind is sharp. I decree my spirit is sensitive. I decree my family is covered. I decree my children are preserved. I decree [music] my household is exempted. I decree sickness has no permission in my body. I decree weakness leaves my system. I decree life flows in every organ. I decree my finances respond to divine order. I decree debt breaks. I decree provision rises. I decree every evil altar raised against my name collapses. I decree every cause dies here. I decree every covenant of delay expires now. I decree what chased me will never catch me again. I decree what mocked me will watch me rise. I decree what resisted me will bow. I decree from today I arrive early into favor. I arrive early into answers. I arrive early into celebration. I decree this season ends well. I decree this month ends in praise. I decree this year crowns me with testimony. Now lift your hands quietly. Father, we seal every word spoken by the blood of Jesus, by the authority of heaven, nothing missing, nothing broken, nothing delayed. The siege is truly over. The verdict is settled. The victory is permanent. Go and walk in it. Go and testify. Go and win early. Those who pray first win first. In the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Amen. Love is rekindled. Now finances final sealed. Hear me. Today you will not spend foolishly. You will not lose money. You will not be cheated. The Bible says in Proverbs 13:22, "The wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just." Provision locates you. Help locates you. Now health final sealed. I speak to your body one last time. Every system aligned. Every organ aligned. Every rhythm aligned. The Bible says in 3 John verses 2, "I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health." Health is enforced. Now destiny, listen carefully. Some of you are closer than you think. The Bible says in Habakkuk 2:3, "Though it tarry, wait for it because it will surely come." I decree acceleration. What was scheduled for later moves forward. This week will surprise you. Now the final prophetic utterances, them quietly. I see doors opening without stress. I see help that does not demand explanation. I see rest replacing anxiety. I see joy replacing pressure. Someone named Steven, you will receive clarity before the day ends. Someone named Aisha, the Lord says delay breaks now. >> [music] >> Someone named John, watch your tone today. Favor is attached to humility. Now, lift your hands. We seal this altar. Father, in the name of Jesus, we place a prophetic seal over this day. The Bible says in Job 22:28, "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established." I decree
